Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_SOSContracts_toolt: Ambushed non-hostile convoys offer rescue escorts. Only verified physical escape earns +3 favor; accepting alone earns nothing. Disabling cancels active SOS contracts.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_SOSTimeoutMinutes_: Time from the ambush until the rescue must finish. Applies to newly opened incidents; active contracts keep their deadline.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_SOSEscapeTiles_too: Distance a surviving NPC-driven convoy must cover with its rescuer nearby after boarding. At least 30 seconds of driving is also required. Applies to new incidents.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_Enabled_tooltip: Off: no new caravans; caravans already on the road finish their trip. Applies within 2 s, also when an admin changes it in a running game.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_MaxCaravans_toolti: How many caravans exist at once (on the road or travelling between towns in the ledger).
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_FoundIntervalMinut: Real minutes between new caravans while there are fewer than the maximum.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_CruiseKmh_tooltip: Convoy speed on the road. Low on purpose: you can catch up in your own car. Military drive 5 km/h slower, raiders 5 faster.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_CrewMax_tooltip: Largest crew. More than the seats of the cars is cut down.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_MaxVehicles_toolti: Up to four cars. Military and police convoys use the maximum; others one to two. Three or four cars are placed in two A-Life units, the second behind the first, and keep formation.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_RenderRadius_toolt: A caravan this close to a player (by the ledger) is put on the road for real. Needs loaded map; too large and it stays in the ledger.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_ReleaseRadius_tool: When every player is this far, the caravan goes back to the ledger and continues its trip there.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_MinSpawnDistance_t: Cars are never created closer to a player than this.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_OfflineSpeedPercen: How fast a caravan travels between towns while nobody sees it, as a percentage of the cruising speed. It slows down to the cruising speed as a player comes within the appear distance, so it never jumps.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_TripsPerCaravan_to: Town-to-town trips a caravan makes before it is retired and a new one is founded.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_HaltSeconds_toolti: How long a flagged-down caravan waits before driving on.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_HornHails_tooltip: Honking within 30 tiles of a caravan asks it to stop (same as the menu).
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_AllowHostile_toolt: Raider and gang caravans: they stop you for a toll and fight when threatened.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_AllowRiders_toolti: A stopped friendly caravan lets a player take a free seat to its destination.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_TradeEnabled_toolt: Stopped caravans sell a few goods for cash.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_EscortContracts_to: A stopped friendly caravan accepts an escort to its destination; stay within 70 tiles. Paid in cash or goods and favor on arrival; ambushes on the way are more likely.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_AmbushPercent_tool: Chance per trip that a horde or raiders wait on the caravan's road while a player is near. The crew gets out, fights, gets back in and drives on.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_RadioChatter_toolt: Convoys within 600 tiles of a player talk on A-Life's Knox County Radio frequency every five minutes.
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_AbandonCars_toolti: A car without fuel or with a dead engine is left behind; the crew continues with the other cars (or on foot until the ledger takes them back).
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_Markers_tooltip: Allow the world map and minimap markers (each player can turn them off in Options > Mods).
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_Debug_tooltip: Extra [ALC] lines in console.txt (founding, rendering, routes).
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_WeatherEffects: Weather and night affect cruising speed
Sandbox_ALifeCaravans_BreakdownChance_to: Chance at each two-minute check for a 45-second roadside inspection. Never destroys the engine. Set 0 to disable.
